concerns.text: Phase 7 (Tasks T055-T058) implements 'Cross-Cultural Stylometric Validation' based on a reviewer's suggestion, but this feature is not authorized by spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008, US-1 to US-4). The spec defines scope strictly around perspective extraction, matching, and regression analysis. There is no task in the spec for collecting 'reflection_text' or performing stylometric correlation analysis. This constitutes unapproved scope creep; the tasks have no matching FR/SC/US in the spec.

Tasks T009.6 and T009.6b attempt to 'fetch external reader-response data' and map it to the local Project Gutenberg corpus via SHA-256 hash. The spec (US-4, SC-006) requires the primary dependent variable to be derived from 'ReaderResponse' data collected from human participants (or a validated proxy) for the *specific* story corpus. External datasets (OSF/HuggingFace) will not contain the exact text of the local Gutenberg stories, making the hash-matching logic impossible to satisfy. No task exists to generate the required local reader-response data (e.g., via a survey simulation or manual annotation of the local corpus) to fulfill SC-006.

Task T025 (matching validation) and T024 (threshold preparation) are marked as failed/rejected in the task descriptions (implied by the analyze report and lack of implementation details). FR-006 and SC-003 require a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds {0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40}. Without a working T025 to generate `matching_results.json` with `threshold_used` fields, and T024 to provide the threshold list, the downstream task T043 (Sensitivity Analysis) cannot execute. There is no active task covering the implementation of the matching logic sweep required by FR-006.

Task T040 (Visualization) is marked as failed/rejected with missing `code/visualization.py` and `data/artifacts/regression_plot.png`. FR-005 explicitly mandates the generation of a scatter plot with a 95% confidence interval. The absence of a valid, active task to implement this visualization means FR-005 is unimplemented and untestable.

Tasks T007.1 and T007.1b assume the existence of an external 'gold-standard perspective annotations' dataset with `text` and `perspective_label` columns that can be mapped to the local corpus via SHA-256 hash. SC-001 requires a correlation ≥ 0.85 against a manually annotated gold standard. If no such public dataset exists with the *exact* text of the Project Gutenberg stories being downloaded (which is highly likely), the mapping will yield zero matches. There is no fallback task defined to manually annotate a subset of the local corpus to satisfy SC-001 if the external fetch fails.

Tasks T055-T058 reference `data/raw/reflections.csv` containing `reflection_text`. The spec's User Story 4 only defines the collection of `empathy_score` and `moral_judgement_score` via survey; there is no task defined to *collect* these written reflections from participants. The tasks reference an input data source that has no upstream generation task in the plan or spec.
